timeline.units: Reference CSS px and target ArkUI vp are authored separately with the same logical offsets.

scenes.interruption: Every tap flips the requested endpoint. Cancel the outgoing run and start from the last applied progress with a duration proportional to the remaining distance. Each marker retraces the same phase mapping. Position, scale and opacity stay continuous. Velocity changes sign immediately.
scenes.accessibility: A labelled Reduce motion control cancels the active run and applies its requested endpoint immediately. Following taps switch endpoints without travel while enabled. The HTML initializes this control from prefers-reduced-motion. The native lab uses the explicit control.
scenes.fallback: Reduced motion keeps endpoint distinctions and removes intermediate movement.
scenes.performance: One Animator drives three stable nodes. Each tick updates one component-local scalar and maps transform, scale and opacity without layout changes.

trackChecks.timeOrigin: Lime marker first crosses 10% of its travel in each capture.
trackChecks.handoff: Inspect rendered positions before and after each direction change. Confirm only the latest run settles.
